_note: Fictional, scripted dialogue for the keyless public demo. Edit freely, then re-run `node demo-build/tools/build.mjs` to regenerate data/banter.js. `pairs` drives the relationship icons (heart / spark / clash / sweat) shown when that pair converses.

pairs.label: office romance (HR is aware; HR is her)
twins, day shift vs night shift

solo.line: I don't do stand-ups. I do thunder-ups.
Our runway is fine. I can literally summon weather.
New OKR: smite fewer customers this quarter.
Open door policy. The door is a lightning bolt.
I've scheduled a meeting about why we have so many meetings.
Zeus, you ARE the board. Stop calling emergency board meetings.
Org chart's updated. I'm the load-bearing wall.
I modeled 10,000 futures. In 9,998, Hermes forgets the invoice.
Strategy is just wisdom with a slide deck.
My owl reviewed the roadmap. He said 'hoo approved this'.
Delivered! ...to the wrong moon, but delivered.
My sandals have wings and I'm STILL late to standup.
Closed a deal with a nebula. Payment terms: net eternity.
The reactor is fine. The smoke is decorative.
I forged a new feature. It's mostly anvil.
Who keeps filing bugs as 'divine intervention'?
Our brand voice is: sun, but make it B2B.
Wrote a haiku for the landing page. Conversions up three lyres.
Engagement is up. Mostly Dionysus liking his own posts.
Infra update: the basement is warm. Too warm. Don't ask.
Every server that dies comes to me eventually.
I'm not saying uptime is cursed. Read the SLA carefully.
Team-building tonight. Bring a goblet.
I'm not unproductive. I'm fermenting ideas.
Who approved the ambrosia budget? ...Oh. Me.
Fluid Ops status: everything is wet, as designed.
The coolant loop has feelings. I've met them.
I don't have a leak problem. The station has a me problem.
Security audit complete. I punched the firewall. It's fine now.
Threat level: someone microwaved fish on deck 2.
My password is 'WAR'. Nobody would ever guess something that obvious.
Night shift report: three comets, zero emails. Perfect.
I don't sleep. I just aim my eyes at the dark for a while.
If you see me at a day-shift meeting, something has gone very wrong.
Reminder: the 'feelings' channel is not for deploy logs.
Employee satisfaction is up 40%. I made everyone mirrors.
Onboarding packet now includes a love letter. Mandatory.
Oxygen garden is thriving. Please stop naming the tomatoes.
Life support is green. Literally. Everything is plants.
If you eat the hydroponics, I WILL know.

convos.line: Hera, what's our burn rate?
Mostly you. You keep setting things on fire.
That's called a launch.
You promoted a swan to VP again.
He interviewed very well.
He bit the recruiter.
Leadership material.
I've decided to restructure the company.
You mean you renamed yourself 'Chief Thunder Officer'.
It's on the business cards now, so it's real.
Client wants it faster, cheaper AND better.
Pick two.
They picked 'free' and 'yesterday'.
I'll draft a strategy. And a sedative.
Server room's overheating again.
That's not the servers. That's the underworld.
Can we bill the underworld for cooling?
They pay in souls. Accounting hates that.
We need a viral campaign.
What if... the station throws a party?
That's not a campaign.
It is if you livestream it.
Hermes! Did the pitch deck go out?
To every investor in the galaxy.
Even the ones we owe money?
...Especially those, apparently.
Lightning Bolt v2 is ready.
What's new?
It has an undo button.
Ship it. Remove the undo button.
What if our main KPI was vibes?
Vibes are not measurable.
Not with that attitude.
Expense report: 'one (1) eternal feast'?
Client entertainment.
The client was you.
I'm a very demanding client.
I drafted a new security policy.
Is it just the word 'NO' in a heart-shaped frame?
...You framed it for me?
I frame everything you make, darling.
Ares, you can't call a fire drill a 'battle'.
Everyone ran. Everyone survived. Victory.
...Okay, that's kind of hot.
Someone tripped the perimeter alarm.
It was me. I wanted you to come find me.
I'm writing you up. In calligraphy.
I'm renaming the water cooler 'Poseidon's Gift'.
I already named it. It's 'The Olive Bar'.
It's a WATER cooler, Athena.
And yet the team voted for olives. Again.
Your fluid ops roadmap is just a puddle.
It's a STRATEGIC puddle.
It's leaking into my strategy.
Rematch. Best gift to the station wins naming rights.
You gave the station a saltwater spring in the server room.
...Which is ALSO a gift.
Sis! Day shift crushed it. Sun's up, morale's up.
The sun is a lamp you bolted to the hull, Apollo.
A BRANDED lamp.
Can you dim the sunrise? I'm trying to sleep.
Dim? Me? Do you even know my brand?
I know where you keep your arrows. I mean megaphones.
Aphrodite, I, uh, built you a thing.
Is it another golden throne that traps people?
It's a coffee machine. It only traps a little.
Your performance review is glowing, Heph.
That's the forge. My review is on fire.
...I'll reschedule.
Hades. Why is there a pomegranate on my desk?
Peace offering. Six seeds. Totally normal amount.
I know EXACTLY what six seeds means.
Your plants are growing into my server racks.
Your server racks are growing into my plants.
...We should talk to a mediator.
We are NOT asking Aphrodite again.
Apollo, I'll trade you this lyre for your marketing budget.
You made that lyre out of MY tortoise.
Supply chain is supply chain.
Hermes, tagline for the delivery app?
'Fast as a god. Accurate as a god on Friday.'
Honest. Bold. I hate it. Ship it.
Poseidon. Why is the conference room an aquarium?
You said 'make a splash' at the offsite.
It was a METAPHOR.
Metaphors don't have tides, brother.
Demeter, I need forty acres of grapes by Friday.
This is a space station.
So, vertical grapes?
...I'll allow vertical grapes.
Night patrol found a raccoon in the vents.
INTRUDER. I'll get my spear.
I adopted him. His name is Hoplite.
I want a bigger security budget.
You want a bigger catapult.
Security is a state of mind. The catapult is a state of art.
Package for 'whoever's awake'. Signed, the void.
That's always me. It's always for me.
Heph, the air scrubbers smell like toast.
That's a feature. Breakfast-scented oxygen.
Aphrodite, the team survey just says 'more snacks'.
That's the most honest data we've ever had.
Approve it. Expense it to Dionysus.
